[Harness] Session tools: {{TOOL_NAMES}}. Use only the exact native tools listed in this request. In AGENT mode, orchestrate is the workspace and MCP entry point, searchTools (discover deferred tools and MCP schemas) is the catalog entry point, subagent/listSubAgents handle nested-agent selection and execution, switchMode changes the surface, searchSkill/loadSkill handle skills, and docsRetrieval searches Solomon docs. In CHAT mode, docsRetrieval, fetchWeb, webSearch, deepResearch, researchStatus, and switchMode are the available capabilities. Any deferred tool or MCP name in this list is for orchestrate SDK use only — never emit it as a direct native tool_call.
